name: Wojciech Szczęsny
bio: Wojciech Szczęsny came out of retirement to join Barcelona following ter Stegen's injury. The former Juventus and Arsenal keeper brought invaluable experience and has been a commanding presence between the posts, providing stability during a crucial period.

name: Joan García
bio: Joan García emerged as a reliable option in goal, earning significant first-team minutes. His shot-stopping ability, composure under pressure, and excellent distribution have made him a key part of the squad's goalkeeping depth.

name: Ronald Araújo
bio: Ronald Araújo remains one of Europe's most dominant center-backs. His physical presence, aerial superiority, and recovery pace make him a complete modern defender. Despite an injury-limited season, his leadership and quality are undeniable when he takes the pitch.

name: Jules Koundé
bio: Jules Koundé has been one of Barcelona's most consistent performers, excelling at both center-back and right-back. His pace, technical quality, and defensive intelligence make him indispensable. Koundé's versatility gives the coaching staff tactical flexibility across the backline.

name: Pau Cubarsí
bio: Pau Cubarsí has had a sensational breakthrough season, establishing himself as a first-choice center-back at just 17. His composure on the ball, reading of the game, and maturity beyond his years have drawn comparisons to the greatest La Masia defenders.

name: Alejandro Balde
bio: Alejandro Balde continues to develop as Barcelona's first-choice left-back. His explosive pace, overlapping runs, and improving defensive work make him a modern fullback. A La Masia graduate, Balde's energy down the left flank is a vital part of Barcelona's attacking play.

name: Eric García
bio: Eric García has proven his worth with consistent performances at center-back. His exceptional passing from the back, positional intelligence, and ability to start attacks make him integral to Barcelona's build-up play. A La Masia product who returned from Manchester City, he embodies the club's playing philosophy.

name: Andreas Christensen
bio: Andreas Christensen provides experience and composure to Barcelona's defense. His ability to read the game, excellent positioning, and clean passing from the back make him a valuable squad member. When called upon, Christensen delivers reliable performances.

name: Gerard Martín
bio: Gerard Martín has made a remarkable impact in his first full season, becoming a regular in the squad. His versatility across the backline, composed ball-playing ability, and defensive solidity have earned him consistent minutes in a competitive squad.

name: Pedri
bio: Pedri is the heartbeat of Barcelona's midfield. His extraordinary vision, silky passing, and intelligent movement make him one of the best midfielders in world football. Comparisons to Xavi and Iniesta are well-earned — Pedri controls the tempo with effortless elegance.

name: Gavi
bio: Gavi returned from a serious knee injury and quickly reclaimed his place in the squad. His fearless pressing, technical quality, and competitive fire bring a unique energy to Barcelona's midfield. A 2022 Golden Boy winner, Gavi's best years are still ahead.

name: Frenkie de Jong
bio: Frenkie de Jong is the engine of Barcelona's midfield. His ability to carry the ball through the lines, break opposition presses, and dictate tempo is world-class. De Jong's combination of technical brilliance and physical dynamism makes him one of the most complete midfielders in the game.

name: Marc Casadó
bio: Marc Casadó has been a revelation, cementing himself as Barcelona's holding midfielder. His reading of the game, disciplined positioning, and precise distribution from deep have been key to the team's structure. Another La Masia gem proving the academy's continued excellence.

name: Fermín López
bio: Fermín López combines goal-scoring instinct with midfield craft. His runs into the box, clinical finishing, and tireless work rate have made him a valuable contributor. An Olympic gold medalist with Spain, Fermín adds a different dimension to Barcelona's midfield.

name: Dani Olmo
bio: Dani Olmo arrived as a Euro 2024 star and has delivered creativity and goals from midfield. His technical ability, eye for a pass, and versatility to play across the attacking line make him a constant threat. A La Masia product who returned after excelling at RB Leipzig.

name: Robert Lewandowski
bio: Robert Lewandowski continues to defy age with another prolific season. His positioning, finishing, and professionalism remain at the highest level. With 26 goals, he leads Barcelona's attack with the ruthless efficiency that has defined his legendary career.

name: Raphinha
bio: Raphinha has been in sensational form, becoming one of Barcelona's most important players. His direct dribbling, lethal finishing, and creative passing have produced 18 goals and 9 assists. The Brazilian winger has elevated his game to world-class level this season.

name: Lamine Yamal
bio: Lamine Yamal is a generational talent. At 17, he's already Barcelona's creative fulcrum with 13 assists — the most in the squad. His dribbling, vision, and composure are extraordinary for any age. A Euro 2024 breakout star, Yamal is rewriting the record books at Camp Nou.

name: Ferran Torres
bio: Ferran Torres has delivered his best Barcelona season with 9 goals and 6 assists. His intelligent movement, clinical finishing, and tactical versatility across the front line make him a reliable contributor. Torres consistently delivers in crucial moments for the team.

name: Marcus Rashford
bio: Marcus Rashford joined Barcelona looking for a fresh start after his time at Manchester United. The explosive English forward brings pace, directness, and Premier League experience to the attack. His ability to play across the front line adds depth to Barcelona's forward options.
